title: No (Verity)
blurb: Flat refusal, no negotiation, no emotion attached. What makes Verity unsettling is precisely that absence — she is not angry with you and not arguing, she has simply declined, and there is no obvious route to appeal. ThatMob's Minecraft horror series built a genuine phenomenon out of a yellow companion whose politeness never quite reaches her voice, and this clip is the moment the friendliness runs out. Use it as the coldest possible rejection sound: a request denied, a favour refused, a suggestion dismissed before it finished being made.
origin: From ThatMob's Verity Minecraft horror series.
